services.name: Treehouse Trails
services.desc: Camp, climb, burrow, and pretend in this enchanted forest setting. Canoe and fish in the blue river, splash in a mountain waterfall, build a fort under the enormous tree house, and serve a stew in the log cabin. Babies can stretch, explore, and relax in the new infant area. Follow the child’s lead if they are drawn to a particular area or activity. Take cues from them on how they want you to join in on the play: Eat a meal they’re serving in the log cabin? Fish together in the creek? Identify words that are specific to the play setting.
